strategy: Technology Leadership + AI/Cloud Transformation + Telecom/Enterprise + Strategic Customer + Strategy-to-Execution
principles: Prioritize recurring gaps with measurable 30-90 day screening value.
Do not attempt to retrofit structural history such as years in a major consulting firm.
Do not infer causality from a single rejection; require multiple comparable outcomes.
Never invent metrics; use only values or ranges defensible in interview.
Do not redirect the profile toward pure hands-on AI/ML engineering unless market outcomes justify it.

priority_gaps.gap: Quantified strategic-account, commercial and transformation impact evidence
market_evidence: Accenture Senior Manager Client Account Lead CMT explicitly requires ownership of revenue targets, pipeline development, account planning, growth strategies, commercial negotiations and account financial performance.
Telefónica Account Executive Grandes Clientes measures revenue, new sales and customer satisfaction.
Telefónica Account Specialist Data/AI expects identification, construction and closure of high-value Data/AI opportunities.
Capgemini Senior Product Owner - Agentic AI requires measurable business outcomes and product success metrics.
AWS Enterprise Account Manager requires identification, negotiation and closure of large-scale technology deals and a proven quota-carrying complex-cloud-sales track record.
priority_gaps.action_today: Complete one Nokia/Telefónica strategic-account evidence block with account/territory scope, quota or target ownership where it actually existed, pipeline/deal examples, confirmed contract/revenue ranges, negotiation role, proposals/RFPs, team scale, transformation delivered and measurable result. Mark unknowns rather than estimate.
priority_gaps.target_evidence: 8-12 defensible quantified achievements across Nokia/Telefónica, CANTV and current AI/cloud work.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: No numeric uplift assigned yet; comparable outcome evidence remains insufficient.

priority_gaps.gap: Production-style Agentic AI / GenAI product delivery evidence
market_evidence: Capgemini Senior Product Owner - Agentic AI requires proven experience developing and delivering Generative AI and/or Agentic AI solutions, plus product ownership from discovery through deployment and improvement.
The role explicitly expects LLM/RAG/embeddings/agents/tool-calling/evaluation/guardrails knowledge, APIs, cloud architecture and enterprise integration fluency.

Accenture AI Manager in Spain requires direct production LLM API work, RAG ownership, LLMOps, cloud-native engineering and shipped production agentic systems; this is evidence of market demand but the role itself is more hands-on than the target positioning.
priority_gaps.action_today: Package one current AI/cloud project as a product case study: business problem, product vision, users, architecture, APIs, agentic/GenAI workflow, cloud deployment, evaluation, guardrails, observability, confirmed adoption/value evidence and lessons learned. Do not invent metrics.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: Expected to materially improve credibility for AI Product/Program and AI Transformation roles; no defensible numeric delta yet.

market_evidence: Telefónica Data/AI significantly values Data Governance and AI Governance credentials.
Telefónica Account Specialist Cloud values architecture, security and networking certifications across VMware, Azure, GCP and AWS.
Accenture CMT Client Account Lead lists cloud, AI, business transformation or project/program certifications as preferred rather than mandatory.
AWS Enterprise Account Manager and Greenfield Account Manager preserve the reusable value of cloud credibility.
Capgemini Senior Product Owner requires cloud platform fluency but does not require a named certification, making portfolio proof more urgent for that role.
plan: P0 Google Cloud Generative AI Leader
P2 AWS Solutions Architect Associate while AWS opportunity density persists
Kubernetes practical evidence before certification unless market frequency rises
priority_gaps.action_today: Continue Google Cloud Generative AI Leader preparation and record completed modules only; do not let certification work delay strategic-account evidence reconstruction or the Agentic AI product case study.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: No numeric uplift assigned until comparable outcome evidence exists.

priority_gaps.gap: Formal major-consulting tenure and consulting revenue track record
market_evidence: Accenture GCC Strategy & Transformation Senior Manager explicitly expects 8-12 years in consulting.

Accenture CMT Client Account Lead is materially more accessible because it accepts strategic account leadership, business development, technology consulting or senior client-facing backgrounds rather than requiring major-firm consulting tenure.
Capgemini Senior Product Owner lists client-facing consulting experience only as desirable.
priority_gaps.action_today: Reframe verified advisory/transformation work as consulting evidence and prefer roles such as Accenture CMT CAL where telecom strategic-account leadership is accepted as an alternative to formal consulting tenure.

market_evidence: AWS Enterprise Account Manager explicitly requires quota-carrying technology field sales and complex cloud solution sales.
AWS Enterprise Greenfield Account Manager requires cloud selling, revenue/adoption pipeline building and complex deal closure.

Accenture CMT Client Account Lead requires revenue target ownership, pipeline development, commercial negotiations and strategic deal pursuits, but does not require cloud quota-carrying history specifically.
priority_gaps.action_today: Extract defensible Nokia/Telefónica or current-role evidence of quota/target ownership, pipeline creation, complex solution selling, negotiated commercial value and cloud-adjacent deals. Do not claim cloud sales where it did not exist.

next_tier.action: TOGAF Foundation + Practitioner after cloud P0/P1.
AWS Solutions Architect Associate after Google P0/P1 unless an AWS interview accelerates the need.
Docker -> Kubernetes -> GKE/EKS deployment evidence; certify only if target-role frequency rises.

outcome_calibration.note: Accenture Principal Agentic AI Transformation Lead - Hands On remains one weak calibration signal for very hands-on Principal Agentic AI roles only. It must not be generalized to product-led Agentic AI roles or the newly detected Accenture CMT Client Account Lead role.
